name: musket-aim-carry
description: D-155 (user 2026-11-22): running lowers the Iron Musket to the right side and it stays there until the aim key (default the mouse wheel button) raises it with the raise animation; fire works only when raised and up; a reload runs while running but not in the air; a torch can be held next to the lowered musket (it shows in the left hand) and the aim key takes it off; block 10 / parry 1.5 / adrenaline 10 and 2 / no movement penalty. Running is set with the test switch musketTestSpeed (the rig takes 7 m/s as the player's speed).
